title: 工资单
problem_statement_md:
给定一个工资单`salaries`，并输入奖金`bonus`。

请将所有的工资都增加到相应的奖金，并输出工资单。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]map[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You work on a payroll program.
Given a [b]list[/b] of salaries, you need to take the [b]bonus[/b] everybody is getting as input and increase all the salaries by that amount.
Output the resulting list.
[note]You can use the [b]map[/b]() function to increase all the values of the list.[/note]
hint_md:
- 可以使用**map**()函数将列表中每个元素增加相应的数值。
- 输出结果列表。

code_templates.template:
salaries = [2000, 1800, 3100, 4400, 1500] # 工资
bonus = int(input())  # 奖金

# 此处完善代码

print(salaries)
code_templates.solution_code:
salaries = [2000, 1800, 3100, 4400, 1500] # 工资
bonus = int(input())  # 奖金

def add_bouns(x):
    return x + bonus

salaries = list(map(add_bouns, salaries))

print(salaries)
